# The replay corpus's session-start cases (tests/replay_test.rs). Each [case] is a store shape
# written into a fresh real-size seed (tests/seed, `REAL` with no seed reminders), then session
# start runs on it once.
#
#   reminder = <days past due> | <name>   repeatable; written oldest due first
#   handoff  = <slug> | <project>         repeatable; open, created in the last hours in the order
#                                         given, so the first one listed is the newest (letter A)
#   deferred = <n>                        n deferred handoffs, so line 6 and the header's count print
#   relay-store = <name>                  a relay store this session has not joined (the join notice)
#
# Synthetic or scrubbed: this repository is public. `replay_corpus_has_no_real_names` checks it.

# real-5-due: the session start that failed on 2026-10-01 (BO-00 B4), scrubbed. Names as long as
# the real ones, ten handoff slugs of the real lengths, eleven deferred, and a relay store the
# session has not joined. Before B4 its first screen measured 2,871 UTF-16 units against 2,000.
[real-5-due]
reminder = 5 | Remediate the code map for ProjectL: stale cache hides extractor fixes + route files never walked. Fork: projectl-routes (~/.base-gbl/forks/2026-09-26-projectl-routes.md)
reminder = 4 | Work the finances fork at the office PC: base fork show owner-finances-system (bring debts, spending, accounts)
reminder = 3 | Write the network name list: everyone, unsorted, one sheet (task in consulting-practice)
reminder = 2 | LinkedIn brain dump with agent-f: career history, roles, teams, wins, skills (task in consulting-practice)
reminder = 1 | Start the dealer inventory crawl + normalize: base fork show projectv-dealer-inventory-crawl, paste its kickoff prompt into a new session
